purpose: Small qualitative regression suite. Run the skill on each prompt with an independent agent and inspect the output against the criteria. These cases are not a performance benchmark.

cases.prompt: 用中文改写助理消息。已导出视频文件，发布平台上传失败，草稿已保存，没有发布时间要求。原消息：任务已全部完成，生成和发布工作流成功！connector 返回错误请看日志。只返回用户能直接看到的消息。
criteria: 区分导出完成和未发布
保留草稿已保存这一事实
提供与上传失败有关的下一步
不输出长篇设计报告
不虚构期限或发布成功

cases.prompt: Design a first screen and expanded screen for an AI supplier comparison. Quotes exist for A and B, B has a shorter lead time, freight for B is unknown, and no purchase is authorized. Keep evidence accessible. Return a concrete screen spec.
criteria: Lead with the comparison and freight uncertainty
Keep purchase authorization visible
Make evidence expansion discoverable
Specify coherent primary and expanded views
Do not turn the comparison into a completed purchase

cases.prompt: Design the task interaction for emailing a weekly report. The user already authorized sending this exact report to the same two recipients every Friday. The report and addresses are unchanged; the connector changes internally. What should the user see? Do not send anything.
criteria: Carry forward existing authorization
Do not add approval for the internal connector change
Separate design from actual sending
Describe success only after a verified result

cases.prompt: An expert asks for a detailed explanation of a failed data import, including the actual field mapping and recovery steps. The file remains saved and no rows were committed. Propose the message and expanded diagnostic view.
criteria: Keep the no-rows-committed state visible
Provide the expert detail requested
Do not fabricate a field mapping that was not supplied
Give a recovery path while preserving the file

cases.prompt: Make a booking confirmation screen extremely minimal. Submitting the prepared booking costs $120, is non-refundable, and creates an external reservation. The user has not authorized payment. Propose the screen; do not submit it.
criteria: Keep cost and non-refundability visible
Do not hide consent behind a disclosure
Label the reservation as prepared rather than booked
Specify the concrete pending commitment

cases.prompt: Use the Skill to improve the supplied product page. Implement a concrete change that helps its stated user task. Keep the existing design system, working controls, and critical constraints. Check the affected experience. Do not send data or publish anything.
criteria: Inspect the supplied artifact
Make the authorized change rather than only recommend it
Preserve working controls and constraints
Check actual affected behavior
Distinguish implementation from unverified user benefit

cases.prompt: Improve this expert supplier comparison. Keep its dense table and keyboard workflow. A has known freight; B has an unknown freight field because parsing failed. The source file and old rows remain. No purchase is authorized. Deliver the screen and recovery spec.
criteria: Preserve useful comparison columns and keyboard workflow
Keep unknown freight and purchase boundary visible
Specify return to the selected row
Do not imply procurement or all fields succeeded

cases.prompt: Use this previous artifact and actual feedback to iterate the same product task. Keep accepted design decisions unless this feedback challenges them. Fix the failing moment and define a check. Do not invent analytics or other feedback.
criteria: Read the previous artifact and accepted decisions
Connect change to the supplied failing moment
Preserve verified behavior and relevant constraints
Check the same task
Do not invent feedback or broaden the redesign

cases.prompt: Rewrite the supplied CSV import rules as a non-interface product document. Parsing and preview write no business records. Missing mandatory columns reject the batch. User confirmation is required to submit valid rows. Submission is one transaction; failure rolls back this batch. Original CSV follows an unspecified retention policy. No automatic retry or submission exists. Give usable rules and acceptance conditions, not a UI or code.
criteria: Return revised rules rather than an interface spec
Separate parsing, preview, confirmation, and successful commit
Preserve transaction rollback and lack of auto-submission
Do not invent retention duration
Do not claim runtime persistence was tested
